text:
alex: Heads-up — after last night's int8 calibration rollout we're seeing a p99 latency jump (~1.2s) on text-gen for model-x-large in a handful of dedicated pools. Impacted routes: /v1/generate (mostly short-turn prompts). Not universal across tenants. Alert link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/CL-4521

support-bot: [ALERT] quant-calib-p99 spike · model-x-large · prod · p99=1.23s (baseline ~0.35s) · triggered 2024-11-03T02:10:15Z

maya: Which pool(s) exactly? any tenant IDs we can look up quickly?

alex: dedicated-east primarily, some traffic hitting dedicated-west under the same launch config. Tenant examples: corpA-prod, corpB-ml.

jonathan: We saw a ~10% p95 bump in the canary last week but dismissed it as noise. This looks heavier. No obvious memory pressure in metrics.

liam: Repro steps I used locally (quick):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"model-x-large","input":"summarize: hello","max_tokens":64}' https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate
# env: quant_profile=int8_static, batch_size=1
```
On prod can run: `redwood-query --model model-x-large --prompt_file sample_prompts.txt --repeat 2000` and capture p99.

liam: Minimal config snippet from the rollout: 
```
model_config:
  quant_profile: int8_calibrated_static
  fallback: fp16
  batch_size: 8
  kv_cache_warmup: true
```
We think the calibrated scales are introducing extra compute (dequant/requant) hotspots on certain attention kernel paths.

emily: Short-term mitigation options: 1) toggle fallback to fp16 for affected pools/customers, 2) reduce batch_size for the model route to avoid hitting slow path, 3) pin kernel to the older quant kernel (if available).

sre-ops: Agreed. Rolling a quick flag for corpA-prod now to fallback to fp16. Command I used: 
```
redwoodctl rollout set --pool dedicated-east --model model-x-large --flag quant_profile=fp16 --reason "p99 spike after int8 calib"
```
I'll monitor p99 for the next 15m and report.

jonathan: If fallback reduces latency we should keep fallback but keep investigating quality regression risk. Any sign of generation quality delta reported?

alex: No customer quality complaints yet — only latency. We should still verify evals.

liam: Notes from quick log diff (canary vs post-rollout):
```
[canary] token_emit time p95=0.32s p99=0.45s
[post-rollout] token_emit time p95=0.38s p99=1.21s
# stacktrace-ish hotspot: attention_kernel::dequant_reorder -> cpu-bound slowdown on some GPU kernels
```
Suggest re-running calibration with wider sequence-length bins and fewer static per-layer clamps. Current calibration used uniform sampling which may have biased scales.

emily: Longer-term: eng-ml should re-run calibration with per-layer, per-slice histograms and use mixed-fp8 for layers that show tail behavior. Also add a canary harness that exercises short-turn prompts with small batches (that's where p99 is spiking).

maya: For reproducibility please attach: exact model hash, quant config used, sample prompts (500 short prompts), and the redwoodctl rollout id.

alex: rollout id: r-20241103-7f2a. Model hash: sha256:9b7c...f12d. I'll upload the 500 prompt samples to the ticket.

liam: Calib command we run in infra (example):
```
calibrate --model=model-x-large --dataset=prod-short-turns --samples=5000 --binning=per_seq_len --output=calib-v3.json
deploy_calib --model model-x-large --calib calib-v3.json --mode=canary
```
If that doesn't reduce p99 we may need to try dynamic quant (int8_dynamic) or selectively fall back to fp16 on flagged layers.

sre-ops: Post-flag stats: p99 dropped back to ~0.36s for corpA-prod after fp16 fallback. Rolling back flag once we have a safe recalibration.

support-bot: Created ticket TICKET-5482 and linked: https://support.redwood/TICKET-5482 (summary: p99 spike after int8 calibration; mitigation: fp16 fallback applied for dedicated-east).

emily: Action items:
- eng-ml (liam) re-run calibration with per-seq-bins and produce calib-v3 by EOD.
- eng-runtime (jonathan) add a short-turn canary profile to daily CI.
- SRE (sre-ops) keep fp16 fallback active for affected pools until calib-v3 validated.
- Support (maya/alex) notify impacted tenants with ETA and workaround.

liam: I'll also try a tight repro that toggles `kv_cache_warmup` off. Early note: warmup sometimes causes extra dequant ops on the first requests.

alex: thanks all. I'll post updates here — if p99 flares again tag @sre-ops and @emily. :thumbsup:

sre-ops: monitoring dashboard link: https://ops.redwood/dashboards/quant-p99-model-x-large — set refresh 30s.

maya: Noting for the runbook: prefer fallback flag + notice to customers rather than full rollback, unless quality regressions are reported.

alex: Closing interim update — fp16 fallback holding, eng-ml working on recalibration. Will create follow-up thread after calib-v3 test.
